text: A anndii - Aan Annabiijo - wonde Alla woni Jooma asamanji e lesdi, Omo ñaawa ko O welaa, O yamira jeyaaɓe Makko ko O muuyi, O haɗa ɓe ko O welaaka, O lelna e sariya ko O welaa, O itta ko O welaa, on ngalaa ballo jogotooɗo geɗe mon sonaa Alla, wonaa kadi ballo deenoowo on gaa bone, ko Alla tan woni baawɗo kattanɗo ɗuum fof.
